dragMethod: Dispatched DragEvent objects with a shared DataTransfer (dragstart on the side card, dragover+drop on the table button, dragend after). The app's own HTML5 handlers processed every event: dragstart set dataTransfer 'text/reservation-id' to the party id, dragover and drop reported defaultPrevented=true, and the app then issued its own tenant-api calls. No keyboard path was needed. Round-1 already established that CDP synthetic mouse drags (and agent-browser's own drag command) do not drive this canvas's native HTML5 draggable/onDragStart/onDragOver/onDrop, so the DragEvent path was used and is documented per assertion.

frictions.description: CDP synthetic mouse drags do not drive the floor canvas's native HTML5 draggable/onDragStart/onDragOver/onDrop (already documented in round 1 for agent-browser and its drag command).
frictions.resolution: Drove the app's real handlers by dispatching DragEvent objects sharing one DataTransfer and verified the handlers processed them (dragstart set text/reservation-id; dragover/drop defaultPrevented=true) and that the app issued its own tenant-api calls. Documented per assertion.

frictions.description: Several floor controls are 'covered' for agent-browser's synthetic click (sidebar aside overlay for the occupied-drop 'Swap tables' button; an inner span for the table buttons), so ref/CSS clicks are refused.
frictions.resolution: Used an in-page document.querySelector(...).click() for those controls (the same friction was recorded in round 1).

frictions.description: One duplicate inactive occupancy row (same table/window, active=0) was present for R2Floor PollHold's original auto-assigned table after its UI unassign. Not reproducible: the same 'Unassigned + Assign Table' action on a fresh party (R2Floor Extra) left exactly one row.
frictions.resolution: Recorded as a non-reproducible data observation; no behavioral effect on any assertion.

summary: Re-tested 6 assertions on /acme/reservations/floor (kody, acme, business date 2026-10-30): all 6 pass. VAL-HOST-014 (the round-1 failure) is fixed end-to-end: an arrived, unassigned party dragged onto empty M4 issued POST /book/reservations/:id/status -> 200 and now persists the assignment (occupancy occ_c38a4ccc on tbl_acme_m4 active=1, seated_at set, event table_changed [] -> [tbl_acme_m4] + seated, day feed tableIds ['tbl_acme_m4']), and the booked path (drag onto M1, POST /assign -> 200, occupancy) also persists. Regressions re-verified: VAL-HOST-012 (shapes round/square/rect/booth/bar + architectural elements in saved positions matching rsv_tables x/y, live colors seated/arrived_waiting/blocked/available, area tabs switch M1-M6 vs T1-T4 vs all), VAL-HOST-013 (guest + covers + elapsed/remaining timer ticks 2m->3m and 1m->2m over a 50 s paused window with 0 GET /book/day and 0 status/assign requests; today's floor shows 'overtime' '+Nm over' highlighting), VAL-HOST-015 (conflict card with swap/reflow/overbook; swap updated both parties: SwapA->M1, Booked->M2, both active occupancies), VAL-HOST-016 (walk-in seated at T2 via POST /walk-ins -> 201, detail sheet opened in place via ?r=, course bussing -> 200, finish -> 200 with table released; block table quick action now POST /blocks -> 201 where round 1 saw a 500), VAL-HOST-017 (held drag ~40 s across the 5 s poll: badge 'Polling paused', 0 network requests during the hold, drop completed with POST /assign -> 200 and occupancy on C1). Console errors: none throughout. Drag method: dispatched DragEvent objects with a shared DataTransfer (handlers verified); native CDP drag does not work on this canvas (round-1 finding).
